title: WRDO: Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization in Aligned Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.29555v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Aligned large language models are trained to comply with benign requests while refusing harmful ones. However, recent work shows that this refusal behavior is fragile and can often be disrupted by simple activation- or weight-space interventions. In particular, refusal has been shown to be largely mediated by a single residual-stream direction, typically computed as a difference-of-means vector between harmful and harmless prompts. However, this standard construction aggregates heterogeneous harmful prompts into one uniform average, potentially conflating distinct refusal-related phenomena. In this work, we study whether refusal interventions can be strengthened by learning how to combine prompt-specific refusal directions. We propose Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization (WRDO), a procedure that constructs a composite refusal direction from a bank of per-prompt directions using learned aggregation weights. translated_title: WRDO：对齐语言模型中的加权拒绝方向优化
translated_abstract: 对齐的大型语言模型被训练为遵守良性请求，同时拒绝有害请求。然而，最近的研究表明，这种拒绝行为是脆弱的，通常可以通过简单的激活空间或权重空间干预来破坏。特别是，已有研究表明，拒绝行为主要由残差流中的单一方向介导，该方向通常被计算为有害提示与无害提示之间的均值差向量。然而，这种标准构造方法将异质的有害提示聚合为一个统一的平均值，可能会混淆不同的与拒绝相关的现象。在本工作中，我们研究是否可以通过学习如何组合针对特定提示的拒绝方向来强化拒绝干预。我们提出了加权拒绝方向优化，该方法利用学习到的聚合权重，从一组针对每个提示的方向库中构建复合拒绝方向。这种方法允许不同……
tldr: 提出加权拒绝方向优化方法，通过学习聚合权重从针对每个提示的方向库中构建复合拒绝方向，以强化对齐语言模型的拒绝干预效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization (WRDO), which constructs a composite refusal direction from a bank of per-prompt directions using learned aggregation weights to strengthen refusal interventions in aligned language models.
